scenes.say: Google just built an AI that cannot write. Not one word. And that is the whole point.
Meet Mujasauraus, my ride buddy on the night road. Tonight, he hits a thousand junctions. And at every one, he needs an answer. Fast.
A normal AI is a chatty passenger. At every turn, it gives him a paragraph. By the time it finishes, he has missed the turn.
The Gemini Decisions API is a co-pilot that just says: left. Ninety four percent sure. No essay.
It says yes or no, picks one option, or scores it. Up to a thousand questions in one call.
And it is fast. Google says about a quarter of a second. At ten cents per million input tokens.
But here is the catch. Those tests came from Google itself. And a rival called Jev wins two of the nine.
So it is great for the same small decision, thousands of times a day. But it can't write, it isn't the cheapest, and you can't host it yourself.
Full sources are on my blog. Follow for a new AI tool every day. Because sometimes, the smartest AI is the one that can't write.
